{{Quote|Acquired new target: Naboo settlement Vis.|OOM-9, during the Invasion of Naboo|audio=VisTarget.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
'''Vis''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] that contained residential buildings, [[Power core/Legends|power cores]], a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]], and a [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]] used for offworld communications. An individual known as the [[Earl of Vis/Legends|Earl of Vis]] was the cousin of an ancient [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|king]] of Naboo. During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Vis was targeted by the invading [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] because of its transmitter. Forces of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] and [[EEK-176]] flanked the forces defending the city and destroyed the transmitter, along with the buildings there.

==Description==
{{Quote|We have secured Vis.|EEK-176|audio=VisSecure.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Naboo_TEA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Naboo, where Vis was located]]
Vis was a small [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="GB" /> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> inhabited by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] population and loyal to the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]]. It was located northeast of the city of [[Parrlay]] and a short distance west of [[New Centrif]]. The eastern side of the city was bordered by a [[Water/Legends|lake]] filled with [[Fish/Legends|fish]]. Vis had two entrances, one on the northwest that connected it to New Centrif and another from the south. The other borders of the city were covered by [[Tree/Legends|trees]]. The ground in the city was covered in paved paths with some [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] patches. The buildings and uniforms of the people in Vis were decorated with [[Color/Legends|purple]] patterns. Two flags adorned the northern entrance, and near them was a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]] and a [[Power core/Legends|power core]].<ref name="GB" />

Above those structures were three residential buildings on a raised stretch of land. Two were square-shaped, while the third was a taller apartment block. In another raised area in the northeast corner of the city there was a [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]] that relayed offworld communications, which was protected by a rectangular light wall. Another circular residential building was placed next to the lake and near a [[Flower/Legends|flower]] bed. South of the transmitter there was a power core and another circular building, which was surrounded by trees on its northern side. The center of the town held a small obelisk monument, while two [[prefab shelter]]s were placed on each side of the path leading to it from the south. Many of the buildings in Vis were similar in style to those used in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. A body of water called [[Lake Vis]] was located west of the city of [[Harte Secur]].<ref name="GB" /> An area on Naboo was called the [[Vis district]], which contained [[Skybridge/Legends|skybridges]].<ref name="End Game">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|OOM-9, we are commencing flanking maneuvers on the Naboo.|EEK-176 during the attack on Vis|audio=EEK-176.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Vis_attack.png|thumb|left|250px|The destruction of the Vis transmitter]]
An individual with the title of [[Earl of Vis/Legends|Earl of Vis]] was a noted historical figure on Naboo and cousin of an ancient [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|king]]. The earl built a large [[Banqueting rotunda/Legends|banqueting rotunda]] in Theed<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|I|224|Earl of Vis}}</ref> and owned a [[Earl of Vis' castle|castle]] in the planet's [[Western Reaches (Naboo)|Western Reaches]].<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> Vis was an early target of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The company wished to prevent word of their invasion from reaching the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and on the personal orders of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], they targeted the transmitters at Vis, New Centrif, and Parrlay. At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the invasion, Vis was defended by eight royal [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] recruits, four royal troopers,<ref name="GB" /> three [[Tuskcat Trooper]]s,<ref name="CC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref> and a [[V-19 landspeeder]]. A strike force of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] led by the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] that included two [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]], four heavy [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|beetle droids]], eight B1 [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], and OOM-9's [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Heavy Armored Assault Tank]], landed on Naboo in a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] and initially approached New Centrif.<ref name="GB" />

OOM-9 deemed that he needed reinforcements to take the city, choosing instead to attack Vis first. Another C-9979 landing craft landed in a clearing south of Vis and unloaded [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by the droid [[EEK-176]], which included four [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], four B1 battle droids, and four heavy [[Beetle/Legends|beetle]] droids. Both groups flanked the people of Vis, [[Death/Legends|killing]] its defenders<ref name="GB" /> and razing it completely, with the beetle droids [[Fire/Legends|burning]] down the transmitter.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> Afterward, the Droid Army attacked New Centrif with their reinforcements, destroying the transmitter there along with the one in Parrlay.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vis was first mentioned in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''.<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> It was identified as a city when it first appeared in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' as a target in the first level of the Trade Federation campaign, entitled "Beachhead." The player has the option of attacking New Centrif first,<ref name="GB" /> but the [[Prima Games]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] by [[Steven L. Kent]] states that the player will lose almost all of their battle droids in doing so and should instead destroy Vis first. The strategy guide also described a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] as the target of the player's attack, rather than a single transmitter.<ref name="Prima" /> The four royal troopers and the V-19 landspeeder are only present in Vis if the player attempts the level on hard difficulty, being absent from the easy and moderate difficulties. The Naboo mounted troopers in the game originally rode [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]],<ref name="GB" /> which were replaced with [[tusk cat]]s in the [[2002]] expansion [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']].<ref name="CC" />
